checkedAlternates.risk: .svg files are XML text under the hood, tempting players to place .svg in Text.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Registered IANA/MDN top-level MIME type for .svg is image/svg+xml (Image, group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: MP4 and WebM containers can carry audio-only streams.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Conventional extension-to-MIME mapping assigns .mp4 and .webm to video/* (Video, group-3).
